modelDescription: The Savage Arms Axis II XP Bolt Action Rifle is an impressive hunting rifle on its own, but add a Bushnell 3-9x40mm Riflescope and you have a reliable, durable, and extremely accurate game taker. Hunting seasons are judged buy meat in the freezer and trophies on the wall, and the Savage Arms Axis II XP Bolt Action Rifle with Bushnell 3-9x40mm Riflescope will help you do both efficiently. When it comes to earning its keep, the Savage Arms Axis II XP Bolt Action Rifle with Bushnell 3-9x40mm Riflescope will impress season after season after season.
